subject: option to read centroided imzML files

messages.author: db2a70d9b31cb1f7
messages.subject: option to read centroided imzML files
parts:
Hi Kylie,

is there an option to read centroided imzML files? I couldn't find anything about centroided data in the readmsidata functions.

I exported some centroided imzML files after peak picking and alignment but when I want to read them in again the spectra are in profile mode.

Thanks,
Melanie

messages.author: 6033d3c0e7d242fa
messages.subject: Re: option to read centroided imzML files
parts:
Hi Melanie,

Sorry for the delay. The actual data will be read the same way regardless, you can just set the "centroided" flag after reading the data in:

data <- readMSIData(...)
centroided(data) <-TRUE

-Kylie
